description: Template for regions where elevation data is available via an OGC WCS 1.0.0 endpoint. Adjust wcs_options to point at your national or regional elevation service. The hydrology defaults are scaled for a 10 m DEM — if your service delivers at a different resolution, update threshold and breach_dist accordingly (see property descriptions in schema.json). Remove or add entries in 'layers' to match the data sources available for your region.
